name: add_tests_js_flatten_one_level
description: Write node:test tests for a one-level array flattener; node-native mutation harness (full-flatten, drops-non-array, stray-undefined mutants)
prompts: flattenOne(arr) in flatten.js (already correct - do not modify it) flattens EXACTLY one level deep - [1, [2, 3], [[4]]] becomes [1, 2, 3, [4]] (the doubly-nested [4] stays nested), non-array elements pass through unchanged, and an empty nested array contributes nothing. Write tests at exactly test_flatten.js using node:test + node:assert (run with `node --test`) with at least 4 test() cases asserting exact deepStrictEqual arrays, covering: a mix of flat and nested elements, a doubly-nested element staying nested (proving it's ONE level, not full recursion), an empty nested array contributing nothing to the output length, and an already-flat array passing through unchanged. Import with `const { flattenOne } = require('./flatten')`.
